The documentary is likely to have a polarizing but significant impact on its target audience, primarily driving a shift in consumer behavior among environmentally and ethically conscious individuals. By exposing the harsh realities of factory farming, the film aims to reduce the social license of industrial animal agriculture, potentially leading to a measurable decrease in demand for conventional meat and dairy products. This could accelerate the growth of the plant-based and cruelty-free markets, forcing major food corporations to reconsider their sourcing and marketing strategies. However, the impact may be limited by entrenched dietary habits and counter-narratives from industry groups, meaning the most profound change will likely occur within existing vegan and vegetarian communities rather than converting the general population overnight.
